units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣从前曾向玉鬘缠绕不清，惹起世人怀疑，如今证明了他的心地清白。

en.t: In the past, the Grand Minister Genji had pursued Tamakazura so persistently that people suspected him, but now his innocence had been proven.

units.source_text: 他回思过去悬崖勒马的事例，觉得自己是一个虽有一时冲动而能不越常轨的人。

en.t: Remembering the times when he had stopped himself at the brink, he felt that although he might be moved by sudden impulses, he was still a man who did not overstep the proper bounds.

units.source_text: 便对紫姬说：“你以前不是也怀疑我么？”

en.t: So he said to Lady Murasaki, "Did you not once suspect me too?"

units.source_text: 但他自知习癖未除，到了热恋不堪之时，难免任情而动，所以情思仍未断绝。

en.t: Yet he knew that his old habit had not left him, and when passion became unbearable he could hardly avoid acting as his feelings led him, so his longing still had not ended.

units.source_text: 有一天昼间，他趁髭黑大将不在家时来到玉鬘房中。

en.t: One day in the daytime, taking advantage of General Higekuro's absence from home, he came to Tamakazura's rooms.

units.source_text: 玉鬘近来心绪异常恶劣，精神萎靡，无有爽健之时。

en.t: Tamakazura had lately been in a very troubled state of mind, listless in spirit and never feeling clear or well.

units.source_text: 听见源氏太政大臣来到，只得勉强起身，躲在帷屏后面接待。

en.t: When she heard that the Grand Minister Genji had arrived, she had no choice but to force herself up and receive him from behind a curtain screen.

units.source_text: 源氏此次特别用心，态度比往时略有改变，说的也是寻常应酬之言。

en.t: This time Genji was especially careful; his manner was somewhat changed from before, and what he said was only ordinary polite conversation.

units.source_text: 玉鬘看惯了那个粗壮而凡俗的髭黑大将，一旦重见源氏这俊秀无比的姿态，

en.t: Tamakazura had grown used to the rough, commonplace General Higekuro, and when she suddenly saw again Genji's incomparably graceful figure,

units.source_text: 想起自己际此意外之遭遇，便觉羞耻得置身无地，眼泪流个不住。

en.t: she thought of the unexpected fate that had befallen her, felt so ashamed that she hardly knew where to put herself, and could not stop her tears.
Their conversation gradually became more intimate.

units.source_text: 源氏将身靠在近旁的矮几上，一面说话，一面向帷屏内窥看。

en.t: Genji leaned his body against a low table nearby, and as he spoke he peered into the space behind the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 但见玉鬘芳容清减，而异常可爱，比以前更增艳丽，更觉百看不厌了。

en.t: He saw that Tamakazura's lovely face had grown thinner, yet she was extraordinarily charming, even more radiant than before, and he felt he could never tire of looking at her.

units.source_text: 他想：“如此绝色佳人，而肯让与他人，我也太慷慨了！”

en.t: He thought, "To have handed over such an incomparable beauty to another man, I was far too generous!"
Filled with regret, he composed a poem on the spot:
